chunks: Mansur ibn Hazim narrated from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام that he said:

Jibra'il عليه السلام descended with the adhan upon the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم while his head was in the lap of Ali عليه السلام. Then Jibra'il عليه السلام pronounced the adhan and gave the iqamah.
When the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم awoke, he said, "O Ali, did you hear?" He said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Did you memorize it?" He said, "Yes."
He said, "Call Bilal and teach him." So he called Bilal and taught him.

key_terms.بِلَالًا: Bilal, who was called and taught the adhan
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: Jibra'il, the angel who descended with the adhan
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: Ali عليه السلام, who heard and memorized the adhan

ai.seo_question: How was the adhan taught to Bilal according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that Jibra'il عليه السلام brought the adhan to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and that Ali عليه السلام heard and memorized it. It highlights the transmission of the adhan through divine instruction and shows Ali's role in teaching it to Bilal.
